description: A contact-capture package: one owned table, a declarative Messages screen, and a public POST /_plugin/contact/submit that validates its body and inserts a row. The screen is drawn from the fields declared here, so a message reads as a message and not as six columns. 1.2.0 adds the optional `company` column, so a firm's enquiry form keeps the name of the firm it came from instead of folding it into the message. 1.3.0 declares the screen as one to work through: a filter on `status`, four handling actions, a delete with its own warning, and a badge counting what nobody has handled. 2.0.0 replaces the per-message notice with one scheduled digest: the host ticks the declared `digest` job, the package reads `notify_email` and `digest_schedule`, and sends one message carrying every enquiry since the last one — or nothing at all when nothing new arrived. `notify_email` defaults to the address of the operator who installed the package.
